history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Voyage Update details. This feature allows the user to update Load voyage, TSP voyage and Discharge voyage for the selected BL.
features: Selected PR&Ds Booking should be in Pre Entered and Entered status.

display.name: Route Group Check Box
display.ui: Selects all bookings under the route group

display.name: Feeder Voyage
display.type: Auto Populate / Alphanumeric + Single Select Drop Down
display.ui: Input Feeder Voyage, it will auto populate. The swap icon switches the voyage box between auto populate and alphanumeric input. Select Feeder Voyage Port from drop down list

display.name: Create leg when not available
display.ui: If the feeder leg is not available please select the check box to create a new leg in the voyage

display.name: Load Voyage
display.type: Auto Populate / Alphanumeric + Single Select Drop Down
display.ui: Input Load Voyage, it will auto populate. The swap icon switches the voyage box between auto populate and alphanumeric input. Select Load Voyage Port from drop down list

display.name: TSP Voyage
display.type: Auto Populate / Alphanumeric + Single Select Drop Down
display.ui: Input TSP Voyage, it will auto populate. The swap icon switches the voyage box between auto populate and alphanumeric input. Select TSP Voyage Port from drop down list

display.name: Discharge Voyage
display.type: Auto Populate / Alphanumeric + Single Select Drop Down
display.ui: Input Discharge Voyage, it will auto populate. The swap icon switches the voyage box between auto populate and alphanumeric input. Select Discharge Voyage Port from drop down list

display.name: Allocation Voyage
display.ui: Input Allocation Voyage, it will auto populate

display.name: Load Terminal
display.ui: Select Load Terminal, it will auto populate

display.name: Destination Terminal
display.ui: Select Destination Terminal, it will auto populate

display.name: Destination ETA
display.ui: Input Destination ETA date and time

display.name: Update Related BLs
display.ui: Switch on to update all related BLs with the changes made

display.name: Update Related Local BLs
display.ui: Switch on to update all related local BLs with the changes made

display.name: Validate
display.ui: Validates the changes made for the selected bookings and shows the result grid

display.name: Process
display.ui: Processes the validated changes for the selected bookings and shows the result grid
